title: Can i make games with deepseek?
author: pikuray
selftext: Hi simple question i noticed deep seek is free so why aren't more people using it. I think i will try it. Only thing i see no preview in the site like others. But I'm a noob at this stuff, thoughts?

comments.author: Affectionate_Fact854
comments.body:
Process will be to slow you might aswell learn to code instead of copy pasting from browser llms 

Using api deepseek is more then capable

comments.author: techtimee
comments.body:
People are using ChatGPT Astra and Anthropic Claude primarily because they have the advanced models, with Astra costing $200/month. 

You can make games with other models, but they may not be as nice and may require more work to set up the production.

comments.author: magokaiser
comments.body:
I got an opencode go sub and started prototyping something with DeepSeek, so far is looking good.

But then I switched to Meta Spark 1.3 because right now is being subsidized.

I only installed pi agent, and gentle-ai (a harness, not sure if its working good for gamedev) and asked the AI to find an mcp for godot.

comments.author: unfamily_friendly
comments.body:
You can. The free mode is only in browser tho. It can't see your project and not very effective

For agents use VScode, plugin "Continue" and deepseek API. It is cheapest of all API and can do the agentic coding

comments.author: Fuzzzy420
comments.body:
Yes you can but there is a very big but. DeepSeek is prone to fail with committed tasks, you will need to prepare each step in very small slices. You can't just say: add feature xy. 
I usually use flash as coder agent with Astra as planning and reflector agent. But deepseek will make mistakes and will need to iterate with tests. 
The price beats the quality in my eyes.

comments.author: Gigaslavx
comments.body:
With free no you need api but as a beginner it will be a lot of trial will be cheap but not stupid though 

Even with experience and api will be mid at that point you invest into something more reasonable. No need blow on astra

Biggest issue everyone pushing ai slop at best you learn how to use ai and general understanding of games you could get otherwise in less time quite low employability factor 

Full ai good for basic browser demos then you need actual expertise you will learn will take a while ai can write majority of code but to save time on failures you'd want to learn every step/before commit attempts
